notes: The reviewed server constructs CCXT exchange clients without exchange API keys and exposes public market-data methods only.
Repository searches found no create_order, cancel_order, fetch_balance or withdraw path in the reviewed source surface.
This is suitable as a reference or future read-only adapter source, not as proof that every future upstream commit remains read-only.
Current and historical perpetual funding rates can complement existing technical context.
The upstream compare_funding tool annualizes venue rates and emits an arb_spread summary.
Crypto Autopilot must preserve venue, raw funding rate, interval and observation timestamp; an upstream arbitrage label must not become a trade instruction.
Open-interest amount/value is useful for derivatives positioning and regime research.
Exchange coverage is capability-dependent and must be fail-closed rather than silently filled from another provider.
Open interest is context only until independently validated against downstream strategy/regime outcomes.
The reviewed implementation uses Binance USD-M global long/short account ratio only.
The metric is venue- and methodology-specific and must retain Binance provenance and period.
It must not be treated as a universal market-positioning ratio across exchanges.
Order book, OHLCV and recent-trade tools overlap capabilities already present elsewhere in Crypto Autopilot and External Market Context V0.1.
They may be useful for cross-provider diagnostics but should not create a second canonical market-data authority.
Liquidation support depends on CCXT venue capability and the upstream default is Gate.
Crypto Autopilot already has a dedicated liquidation-source candidate, so this surface is better treated as a cross-check than primary liquidation authority.
The upstream runtime uses bounded retries, per-request/overall timeouts, per-exchange concurrency limits and short TTL caches.
Those patterns are useful operational references, but importing the runtime is unnecessary for the first integration stage.
HTTP mode adds bearer-key tiers, quotas and optional gateway trust.
Crypto Autopilot does not need to run or monetize this MCP server.
No hosted key, gateway-bypass configuration or billing tier is authorized by this evaluation.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Build a no-network prefetched derivatives-context contract for funding, open interest and Binance long/short ratio using synthetic/non-holdout fixtures only; preserve venue, symbol, observation time and availability time; do not alter Strategy Router or Daily Opportunity behavior until a separate validation.
